fusions.name: Skewering Leap
fusions.desc: You leap onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and drive a spike into it, dealing 14 damage, rising to 1.5 times as much the further you leapt.

fusions.name: Springing Thorn
fusions.desc: Flicks a barb that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hop dealing 60% of the original damage. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Hard to Swat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. You move 25% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Itch Under the Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a barb lodges in that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a barb works loose every 4 seconds.
